decision_conditions: It has not been demonstrated that the proposal would comply with Condition B.1 (e)(i) (the construction or provision of a verandah, balcony or raised platform) of Class B, Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

It has not been demonstrated that the proposal would comply with Condition B.2 (i) (aa) (the eaves of the original roof are maintained or reinstated) and (bb) (edge of enlargement closest to eaves of the original roof shall, so far practicable, not be less than 0.2 metres from the eaves, measures along the roof slope from the outside edge of the eaves) of Class B, Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

It has not been demonstrated that the proposal would comply with Condition B.2 (c) (any window inserted on a  wall or roof slope forming a side elevation of the dwellinghouse shall be -  (i) obscure - glazed, and (ii) non- opening unless the parts of the windows which can be opened more than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed) of Class B, Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

It has not been demonstrated that the proposal would comply with C.1 (b) (the alteration would protrude more than 0.15 metres beyond the plane of the slope of the original roof when measured from the perpendicular with the external surface of the original roof) of Class C , Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
